_note: The ONE place to retime the film. Edit the scene 'start' values (seconds) to the measured voice-over timings, then re-run _work/capture.cjs. Every animation is keyed as an offset from its scene start; 'end' is informational (a scene ends where the next starts). Starts are ESTIMATES until the audio is measured.
